extracted.name: Fortune Cookies
extracted.description: Crunchy and tasty, full of wisdom...we all love reading our future by cracking one of these lovely cookies! Complete video link: https://youtu.be/aedwn6nF9Pc
instruction_lines: Compose the messages, print and cut them in thin strips to be easily inserted into the cookies
Add the egg white in a bowl and add sugar in it
Place th into the mould (cupcake tray)while warm to set till completely cool
Add flour in portions and start folding in
Add just enough milk to create a thick batter(like pancake)
Preheat the oven.align baking sheet on a baking tray
Using a spoon add spoonful of batter and spread into 3.5-4cm wide circle on a baking tray
Bake for 8-10 min only at 160 degress celcius (the cookies will still be soft)
Before they completely cool,add your messages in the cookies and fold them into cookies
The cookies will ready once cool.Enjoy!
Watch the video for the complete detailed process and cookie folding technique:https://youtu.be/aedwn6nF9Pc
